fields.caption: i hid a 6502 cpu in qwen weights; mario now runs 290× slower

narrative_summary: A smug blob proudly turns Qwen weights into a deterministic NES emulator that makes Mario crawl at glacier speed.
rationale: Candidate 2 has the cleanest collision between a specific technical fact—the 6502 hidden in Qwen weights—and the absurdly bad outcome of Mario running 290× slower. Disaster Girl suits the proud, self-inflicted engineering failure, and the caption lands with a sharper reversal than the more cluttered comparison in Candidate 4.
